record_title: Heterogeneous order-statistic marginals: pointwise recovery, label braiding, and analytic identification
provenance: An inverse-order-statistics result: all rank marginals determine the pointwise multiset of heterogeneous parent CDFs, reducing global identification to a label-matching problem across crossings.
limitations: Requires independent parent variables and the marginal law of every rank. The analytic corollary is structural identification, not a finite-sample stability result; C-infinity regularity alone does not identify global labels, and recovery is ill-conditioned near crossings.
